scripts.format:check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const walk=(d)=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((e)=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):[path.join(d,e.name)]);const files=[...walk('app'),...walk('fixtures'),...walk('src'),'package.json','tsconfig.json','next.config.ts','eslint.config.mjs'];for(const file of files){const text=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');if(!text.endsWith('\n')||text.split('\n').some((line)=>/[ \t]+$/.test(line)))throw new Error('format '+file)}"
